nodes.label: Omitted previousDeviceId contract
nodes.description: A new device must omit previousDeviceId; explicit null remains a server-side 400. Selected IDs must be positive safe integers.
nodes.rationale: The strict server contract accepts a positive integer or an absent field, so nullable UI serialization violates the contract.

nodes.label: buildPreviousDeviceSelection
nodes.description: Pure UI helper returns an empty object for a new device; form submission spreads its result and CreateRepairCaseInput excludes null.

nodes.label: Six role create authorization validation
nodes.description: Local tests allow manager and reception to create synthetic cases; technician, QC, inventory and finance receive 403 without writes. Exact retries are read-only.

nodes.label: A04 local validation boundary
nodes.description: 193 Node scenarios and five local D1 wrappers passed; browser, hosted Worker/network and hosted D1 were not run. The published root remained a static status/demo and A05/A06 were still pending.
nodes.rationale: Local payload and handler evidence cannot justify browser E2E or operational readiness claims.

nodes.label: 20261011W A05 versioned submit checkpoint
nodes.description: Historical Worker migration report wiring authoritative device and recovered-draft versions into create_case; schema, migrations, menus and endpoints were preserved.

nodes.label: Versioned previous device selection
nodes.description: buildPreviousDeviceSelection emits either no selection or the complete previousDeviceId/expectedDeviceVersion pair; invalid or missing versions fail before dispatch.
nodes.rationale: A selected existing device must carry the authoritative version of the same record to reject stale writes without creating a duplicate device.

nodes.label: Versioned draft submission selection
nodes.description: buildDraftSubmissionSelection emits no draft selection or the complete draftPublicId/draftExpectedVersion pair. Recovered and first-save versions remain in form state.
nodes.rationale: A draft identifier and its authoritative version must travel together so conversion is atomic and stale drafts cannot be submitted.

nodes.label: Authoritative version provenance
nodes.description: Device versions originate in real customer lookup and draft versions in operations listing/server save responses; case-snapshot history cannot replace authoritative lookup and no fabricated fallback is introduced.
nodes.rationale: Version checks are trustworthy only when the UI preserves the server version associated with the selected record.

nodes.label: A05 local validation boundary
nodes.description: 197 Node scenarios and five local D1 wrappers passed, including six-role create/save, stale 409 and read-only retries. Browser and hosted environments were not run; A06 autosave/discard versioning remained open.
nodes.rationale: Source/type/serialization/local SQLite completion does not prove pilot readiness or browser behavior.

nodes.label: 20261011X A06 draft mutation checkpoint
nodes.description: Historical Worker migration report wiring authoritative versions into autosave/discard and exposing conflicts, with unchanged schema, eight migrations, menus and endpoints.

nodes.label: Serialized versioned draft mutation queue
nodes.description: Draft mutations for a form execute sequentially, each consuming the prior response version. Initial create omits expectedVersion; subsequent edits include it.
nodes.rationale: Debounce alone cannot prevent overlapping requests, and the previous adapter omitted expectedVersion for edits and deletion.

nodes.label: Visible draft conflict recovery
nodes.description: API errors preserve HTTP status and tracking code. A 409 pauses autosave and displays a draft-version conflict with recovery of the saved authoritative version; non-conflict errors are visible too.
nodes.rationale: Swallowed autosave failures hid unsuccessful writes from the operator, and continued writes after a conflict could overwrite newer data.

nodes.label: Versioned draft discard
nodes.description: A confirmed discard appears only for a saved draft, waits for the mutation queue and submits publicId with the current expectedVersion; success reloads authoritative state and conflicts use recovery.

nodes.label: A06 local validation boundary
nodes.description: 201 Node scenarios and five isolated D1 wrappers passed, covering versions 0 to 1 to 2, stale/retry/race, role restrictions and no duplicate audit. Browser/hosted tests were not run and an older D1 API smoke remained INCOMPLETE_tool_access.
nodes.rationale: Local queue/handler/SQLite evidence does not demonstrate browser warning interaction or pilot readiness.

nodes.label: 20261011Y A08 case mutation checkpoint
nodes.description: Historical Worker migration report carrying authoritative case versions through operations and UI PATCH mutations; schema, eight migrations, 23 tables, menus and V2 contracts were preserved.

nodes.label: Authoritative case optimistic lock
nodes.description: RepairCaseRecord preserves D1 row_version as expectedVersion; every UI case mutation sends that snapshot version and refreshes authoritative data on success or 409. PATCH replaces the prior 503 gate.
nodes.rationale: The UI previously dropped row_version and sent no expectedVersion, preventing valid mutations from being distinguished from stale writes.

nodes.label: Atomic case event audit batch
nodes.description: A D1 batch guards UPDATE by case ID, shop, branch, row_version, status and active membership/permissions, then writes exactly one event and one audit only on update success. Evidence-write failure rolls the case back.
nodes.rationale: Atomic evidence and guarded updates prevent overwrite, duplicate evidence and partial writes during stale requests, revocation or reassignment races.

nodes.label: Scoped case mutation authorization
nodes.description: PATCH accepts only same-origin bounded JSON at /api/operations.php with identity/shop/branch-bound CSRF and server scope. Manager/reception and assigned technician/QC may mutate within their roles; inventory/finance remain forbidden even when issued scoped tokens.

nodes.label: Workflow V2 status ownership
nodes.description: Any explicit or implicit status change for workflow-managed cases receives 409; assignment from awaiting_assignment cannot bypass the process engine. Non-stage reports/results remain supported.
nodes.rationale: Workflow V2 status transitions must originate only from the workflow engine.

nodes.label: A08 local validation boundary
nodes.description: 206 Node entries and six fresh local D1 wrappers passed, covering role matrix, stale/retry/race, atomic rollback, revocation and V2 transitions. Browser/hosted Worker/D1 were not run; the published root remained a private static status/demo.
nodes.rationale: Local source/type/Request-Response/SQLite evidence does not establish deployment or pilot readiness; session/logout remained the next checkpoint.

nodes.label: 20261011Z A09 auth session checkpoint
nodes.description: Historical Worker migration report introducing POST/DELETE auth and single-active-session rules using in-memory SQLite and local Wrangler D1. 217 Node entries and seven local wrappers passed; no browser or hosted API/D1 testing or operational deployment occurred.

nodes.label: Site identity operational session
nodes.description: Official Site identity remains the login authority. A separate Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie holds the raw session while D1 stores only SHA-256; identity and CSRF GET stay pre-session, protected transferred data routes require a session.
nodes.rationale: An independent login or OAuth flow was unnecessary because Site identity already maps users and memberships, but prior writes did not enforce the operational session.

nodes.label: Single active session compare and swap
nodes.description: A second login compare-and-swaps the active session hash, revokes the old session and records revoked/login atomically; central admin is exempt from the branch hash under the reference rule.
nodes.rationale: The legacy single-active-session rule must remain true during concurrent login and event-write failure.

nodes.label: tamiran_user_session_events
nodes.description: The ninth append-only migration adds a scoped session-event table with reference foreign keys, enums and indexes. Session replacement and its events roll back together on race or write failure.

nodes.label: Conditional idempotent logout
nodes.description: DELETE /api/auth.php conditionally clears the matching active session and is idempotent; an old cookie cannot delete a newer session. The UI performs DELETE before official Site sign-out.
nodes.rationale: Logout must revoke only its own session so a delayed old request cannot invalidate a later login.

nodes.label: Incomplete session expiry policy
nodes.description: Idle/absolute expiry and credential-change revocation remain unimplemented in this historical checkpoint; expired/password_changed events and time/concurrency tests are the next work. The eight-hour cryptographic CSRF validity does not establish completed session expiry.
nodes.rationale: Session-cookie behavior and CSRF validity are insufficient evidence that the full idle/absolute expiration policy has been migrated.

nodes.label: Historical Worker vinext starter README
nodes.description: README within the historical migration/worker tree describing the Vinext/Sites Worker starter, execution profiles, optional Cloudflare D1/Drizzle, identity integration and local commands. It is not documentation of current PHP hosting.

nodes.label: Vinext Worker starter
nodes.description: A full-stack Vinext starter with optional Cloudflare D1/R2 and Drizzle. The Worker uses vinext/server/fetch-handler, and local npm start runs the built artifact through Wrangler with shared local state.

nodes.label: Portable and managed Linux execution profiles
nodes.description: Sites selects managed Linux only when SITES_MANAGED_LINUX_CONTAINER=1; otherwise portable. An ignored local profile controls install/build/preview differences. Portable mock sign-in is loopback-only and excluded from production; managed preview is supervisor-owned.

nodes.label: Dispatch owned Sign in with ChatGPT
nodes.description: Dispatch injects stable per-Site user ID and identity headers and owns reserved sign-in/sign-out/callback routes and OAuth cookies. SIWC begins via top-level navigation; server-only helpers expose optional/required identity and sign-out paths.

nodes.label: Identity and membership separation
nodes.description: SIWC establishes identity, while hosting access policy or explicit server-side membership/allowlist checks establish access. Stable userId keys user-owned records; email/name are display/contact data.
nodes.rationale: Authentication alone does not prove workspace membership, and email is not a durable per-user key.

nodes.label: Local D1 migration lifecycle
nodes.description: Generate SQL with db:generate, build dist/server/wrangler.json, and apply pending migrations sequentially via local Wrangler using .wrangler/state. Do not replay applied migrations; production migrations occur separately at publishing.
nodes.rationale: Local state and generated binding config must remain consistent, and local migration success must not be mistaken for production database changes.
